name: Breksos CRM
description: A sales pipeline you and your agent share — whatever either of you opens, logs or moves, the other is looking at it too.

commands.name: find
commands.about: search contacts, companies and deals — results land in the shared list

commands.name: show
commands.about: one record in full, and open it in the window

commands.name: board
commands.about: the pipeline: every stage, its deals and its totals

commands.name: due
commands.about: next steps that are overdue, due today, or due this week

commands.name: status
commands.about: what both surfaces are looking at, plus counts and connected agents

commands.name: export
commands.about: write records as CSV or JSON; prints the file path

commands.name: add
commands.about: create a company, contact or deal

commands.name: log
commands.about: record a call, email, meeting or note against a record

commands.name: move
commands.about: change a deal's stage, or close it won or lost

commands.name: task
commands.about: set a next step with a due date

commands.name: link
commands.about: associate a contact, company and deal

commands.name: archive
commands.about: retire a record, or restore one — never a delete

commands.name: select
commands.about: answer a pending question, or open result N

commands.name: import
commands.about: read records from a CSV or vCard file
